name: Why is my water bill suddenly so high?

mainEntity.name: Why is my water bill suddenly so high?

acceptedAnswer.text: A sudden increase in your water bill often indicates a hidden water leak. Common culprits include running toilets, leaky faucets, or underground pipe leaks. Other factors can include a malfunctioning irrigation system, a water softener continuously regenerating, or even a neighbor using your outdoor spigot. It's important to investigate promptly, as unattended leaks can waste thousands of gallons of water and cause significant property damage over time. Contacting a professional plumber can help identify the exact cause.
acceptedAnswer.description: A sudden high water bill usually points to a hidden leak or a malfunctioning water-consuming appliance. Prompt investigation is crucial to prevent further waste and damage.
